title: a host-seam crossing clears on this box's verify seal
intention: A host-seam ticket's crossing through the clearance gate names its owning intention as the proof, and clearance judges that proof by this box's host-seam standing(), so a verify sealed on this box clears the crossing and an unsealed or drifted one refuses.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 by the orchestrator: a no-target sail.py cross of host-seam tickets 496dcbeba174 and b1f182b6b818 refuses 'the crossing names no proof at all', because gate.declaring() finds no proofs/*.py whose PROVES names them, and dfe6c1432fc8 kept clearance out of bounds.
traces_to: Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof; for a host-seam the proof is the box-local verify seal (CairnCommons/node_classes/host-seam.json prove_gate).
how: D1: ClearanceGate.crossing_of names the ticket's owning_intention (resolved under the commons) as proven_by when the ticket's node_class is host-seam. D2: clearance rule 2 is unchanged (standing() already dispatches host-seam); rule 2b's _coverage_lacks takes a proven host-seam standing as that entry's coverage instead of PROVES teeth and the hollow reading. D3: red-first proof over a fixture host-seam ticket in a scratch crossing world.

clauses.claim: the gate's crossing for a fixture host-seam ticket names its owning intention as proven_by, and a non-host-seam ticket's crossing is unchanged
a host-seam crossing whose intention has no seal on this box is refused as not in proven-space; after cli --host-seam --seal it clears, rule 2b included
after a host fact moves, the same crossing is refused again, the refusal naming the moved fact

decisions.text: D1: crossing_of reads node_class off the ticket's workflow (parse_workflow(ticket.workflow).node_class); for host-seam, proven_by = [absolute path of owning_intention under the commons], else the existing proven_by().

D2: _coverage_lacks skips proof_coverage.lacks and hollow_lacks for a named path where validation_store.is_host_seam(path), and adds a lack when standing(path) is not proven; every other named proof keeps both instruments.

D3: one proof, one tooth per clause, standing a fixture world the way test_the_proven_space_rule_follows_the_ticket_kind.py does, with a fixture host-seam intention shaped as in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_host_seam_seals_on_this_box_only.py; host facts patched by wrapping validation_store.host_facts.

measured.saw: gate.declaring() returns no proof for 496dcbeba174 or b1f182b6b818; clearance.py:1446 refuses an empty _named
measured.how: grep -rl 496dcbeba174 over proofs/ (only a docstring) and reading gate.py:137-147, clearance.py:1443-1450
